text:
maria ortega: Hi everyone  Maria here, joining Platform Core today (IC2). Quick intro + a few setup asks so I can get unblocked: 
- I'm in CLT (UTC-4). Does that affect oncall assignment?
- Laptop: will accept whichever IT ships, but curious about MDM flow for Apple Silicon vs Intel.
- Need Console read access to 'platform-core' org and a small dev-gpu quota for local model tests.
- Fun fact: amateur beekeeper (ask me about honey tastes!). :honey_pot:

olin (people ops): Welcome Maria!! :tada: 
- Oncall: we'll put you in a timezone-aware pool; note your CLT preference and we can avoid graveyard shifts unless you opt in.
- MDM: enroll at https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll and pick the image that matches the device. IT aims to provision within an hour of enrollment.
- Console / quota: please confirm the exact org slug (looks like "platform-core") and I'll file IAM + quota requests. I'll also assign you a buddy.

jasper (devex): Hey Maria  hi! I'm your buddy for week one. Quick starter checklist:
- Add SSH key: https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys
- If you're doing local GPU work, include a short note on the quota form (type of experiments + expected hours).
- Test jump host access: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 maria@jump.redwood.com`
- If you want, we can screenshare later to verify Console perms.

tess (eng): Added you to #eng and the rotation draft. You'll get PagerDuty DM once provisioning finishes. For the dev-gpu quota, put "research-prototyping (low)" on the form and tag me so I can approve faster.

welcome-bot: New hire checklist created for maria.ortega@example.com. Enrollment pending: MDM (user action), IAM (pending), equipment (monitor request: none).

maria ortega: Thanks all  enrolling now and filling the quota form (I'll tag Tess). Jasper, a screenshare late afternoon CLT would be great. Also sending DM to Olin with my shipping address for stickers. :wave:

jasper (devex): Sounds good  ping when you're on VPN and we can do a 20-min call to finish SSH/Console. Also pro tip: `brew install --cask raycast` if you like quick app launcher shortcuts.

olin (people ops): Sticker pack + welcome note queued. Welcome to Redwood, Maria! :confetti_ball:
